_comment: Per-landed-sprite placement tuning for the Mars ground UFOs. Authored with wwwroot/landed-editor.html; loaded by Compat/LandedOffsets.cs. Design-space px (800x600), +x right, +y down. 'landed' shifts the parked still; 'takeoff' shifts the ship once on lift-off (feet compensation); 'shadow' nudges the ground shadow (x, y along the floor line); 'shadowSize' multiplies the shadow width. Identity (0s, shadowSize 1) = original untuned behaviour.
